title: Brazilian Cheese Wrap
description: A simple and delicious cheese-filled Brazilian wrap. This recipe is a delightful twist on traditional cheese wraps.
instructions: Heat a large non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Butter or spray the pan with non-stick cooking spray.
Place the flour tortilla in the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Flip the tortilla and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Add gouda cheese on top of the shredded cheese.
Sprinkle wrap seasoning on top (if using).
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the cheese is melted.
Flip the wrap and cook for another 1 minute.
